Livpure India Livpure Smart I am very much dissapointed with your service. I’ve been a loyal Livpure customer for years, but going without clean drinking water for over 20 days because of zero customer support is where I draw the line.
Technicians call to confirm my address and then completely ghost my calls afterward. No one shows up, and customer care has been entirely unhelpful.
Fix this immediately.

Livpure Smart Livpure India

comment: Service failures become bigger trust issues when essential products are involved. Companies need escalation paths that track ownership, not just ticket numbers, especially for critical home services.
